subject: TURN directive
notes: kb/Work PB1365 (wave 1019 B re-probe on a fresh build). The printed diagram (PDF p115) underlines TURN, CHECKING, OFF and LOCATION only, so ON and WITH are optional words (cite.py --check 7.3.25.4 'If the ON phrase is specified or implied' OK 6)). ParseTurn reads { exception-name [file-name]... }... CHECKING [ON] [[WITH] LOCATION] | OFF and ends the operand there: CHECKING / CHECKING WITH LOCATION / CHECKING LOCATION / CHECKING ON LOCATION all select ON (checking takes effect: pb1365_turn_checking_implied_on); CHECKING OFF WITH LOCATION, CHECKING ON JUNK, CHECKING JUNK, CHECKING WITH and a directive with no CHECKING are COBOL0718; EC-I-O ON / LOCATION as file-name-1 is COBOL0718 (SR-7.3.25.3-1); the exception-name/file-name ellipses accept several of each. All re-run: turn_ok / turn_impl / turn_impl_loc / turn_on_loc_nowith / turn_comment run, the rest are rejected.
